rules.title: General Law - Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 12
rules.requirement: A tenancy at will may be terminated by either party with three months' written notice or a shorter notice equal to the rent payment interval if less than three months. For nonpayment of rent, a landlord must give a 14-day written notice to quit, which can be prevented if the tenant pays the full rent due within 10 days of receiving the notice, provided no similar notice was given in the prior 12 months.
rules.key_value: 3 months' notice; 14 days for nonpayment with 10-day cure
rules.summary_plain: If you rent with a tenancy at will, your landlord must give you three months' written notice to end your tenancy, or 14 days' notice if you haven't paid rent. You can stop eviction for nonpayment by paying the rent within 10 days if you haven't been given a similar notice in the past year.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquilas con un contrato de tenencia a voluntad, tu arrendador debe darte un aviso por escrito de tres meses para terminar el contrato, o un aviso de 14 días si no has pagado la renta. Puedes evitar el desalojo por falta de pago si pagas la renta dentro de 10 días y no has recibido un aviso similar en el último año.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to estates at will (tenancies at will) under Massachusetts law.
rules.quoted_span: Estates at will may be determined by either party by three months' notice in writing for that purpose given to the other party; and, if the rent reserved is payable at periods of less than three months, the time of such notice shall be sufficient if it is equal to the interval between the days of payment or thirty days, whichever is longer. ... In case of neglect or refusal to pay the rent due from a tenant at will, fourteen days' notice to quit, given in writing by the landlord to the tenant, shall be sufficient to determine the tenancy; provided, that the tenancy of a tenant who has not received a similar notice from the landlord within the twelve months next preceding the receipt of such notice shall not be determined if the tenant, within ten days after the receipt thereof, pays or tenders to the landlord ... the full amount of any rent due.
